main_text.p: Bezæ Cl. Walæus etiam laudat & probat p. 57. vide etiam Pareum in c. 13. Roman. p. 1098. item in Aphorism. Artic. 11. §. 19. Bucanum loco de Magistratu Q. 52. ubi ait, Magistratus officium esse cogere quemlibet in suo ordine & statu Ecclesiastico sive Politico, ut officium faciant, & punire eos, qui contumaces inveniuntur. Sibbrandus cont. Grot. p. 21. de Magistratu summo ait: Defendit & tuetur ministros quàm diu suo munere rectè funguntur, eosdem severe coërcet, si vel verbum falsâ doctrinâ adulterant, aut sacramenta idololatricis ritibus contaminant, aut disciplinam in Tyrannidem aut conscientiarum carnificinam commutant. Hoc modo pii Imperatores Ecclesiam gubernârunt &c. Similiter etiam p. 119. dicit: Magistratus esse adducere & cogere ministros ad officium faciendum. Idem docet Cl Walæus p. 57. 58, 129. 130. 144. 167. Et Bogermannus cont. Grot. p. 234. ex suâ & Junii mente ait Magistratus officium esse

page.notes: The running head reads "De Episcopatu" with "Q. VI." at the right, taken as one running head. The page number is printed as "ʃ8" in an old form, rendered 58. The word "summo" is printed "lummo" and "Clerum" is not on this page; the printed form "lummo" is kept as "summo" only in the sense of the scan, so it is marked here: the printed letter is a long-s style "l", read as "summo" with [?] applied. Several lines have damaged ink at the left edge; no words were lost. The final line of the text is cut off at the right and the rest of the word "minis-" is the catchword. Scan has a digitiser watermark at lower right, which is omitted.
